svg.title: What USPS says about Package Pickup and Pickup on Demand: cost, timing, cutoff, limits, postage and what happens after scheduling.
svg.text: USPS Package Pickup
What USPS's pages say
Package Pickup (free)
Free, however many items are scheduled.
Next delivery day or a day you choose,
at the time the carrier delivers mail.
Schedule, edit or cancel until 2:00 AM
Central Time on the day (Mon to Sat).
Pickup on Demand (fee)
A fee per trip (listed in Notice 123).
A two-hour window you choose.
Schedule, edit or cancel until 5:00 AM
local time on the day (Mon to Sat).
Limits
Each item: up to 70 pounds and 130
inches in length and girth. Postage
prepaid before pickup. Stamps only on
items of 10 oz or less and 1/2 inch or
less thick. Not all addresses eligible.
After you schedule
Up to 6 months ahead. Leave the package
where you chose; you need not be there.
Snow, ice, blocked paths or dogs may
prevent a pickup.
Sources: USPS FAQ, USPS.com, Schedule a Pickup;
no update dates; read Nov. 9, 2026
